entries.title: Job 22:1
segments: ¶And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 22:2
segments: Can a man be profitable to *God? surely it is unto himself that the wise man is profitable.

entries.title: Job 22:3
segments: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty if thou art righteous? And is it gain [to him] that thou makest thy ways perfect?

entries.title: Job 22:4
segments: Will he reason with thee for fear of thee? Will he enter with thee into judgment?

entries.title: Job 22:5
segments: ¶Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities without end?

entries.title: Job 22:6
segments: For thou hast taken a pledge of thy brother for nought, and stripped off the clothing of the naked.

entries.title: Job 22:7
segments: Thou hast not given water to the fainting to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

entries.title: Job 22:8
segments: But the powerful man, he had the land; and the man of high rank dwelt in it.

entries.title: Job 22:9
segments: Widows hast thou sent empty away, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

entries.title: Job 22:10
segments: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

entries.title: Job 22:11
segments: Or darkness, that thou canst not see, and floods of waters cover thee.

entries.title: Job 22:12
segments: Is not +God in the height of the heavens? And behold the summit of the stars: how exalted are they!

entries.title: Job 22:13
segments: And thou sayest, What doth *God know? will he judge through the dark cloud?

entries.title: Job 22:14
segments: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh on the vault of the heavens.

entries.title: Job 22:15
segments: ¶Dost thou mark the ancient path which wicked men have trodden?

entries.title: Job 22:16
segments: Who were carried off before the time, whose foundation was overflowed with a flood;

entries.title: Job 22:17
segments: Who said unto *God, Depart from us! and what could the Almighty do to them?

entries.title: Job 22:18
segments: Yet he filled their houses with good. But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 22:19
segments: The righteous see it, and are glad; and the innocent laugh them to scorn:

entries.title: Job 22:20
segments: Is not he who rose against us destroyed, and doth not the fire consume his residue?

entries.title: Job 22:21
segments: ¶Reconcile thyself now with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

entries.title: Job 22:22
segments: Receive, I pray thee, instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in thy heart.

entries.title: Job 22:23
segments: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up. If thou remove unrighteousness far from thy tents,

entries.title: Job 22:24
segments: And put the precious ore with the dust, and [the gold of] Ophir among the stones of the torrents,

entries.title: Job 22:25
segments: Then the Almighty will be thy precious ore, and silver heaped up unto thee;

entries.title: Job 22:26
segments: Yea, then shalt thou delight thyself in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto +God:

entries.title: Job 22:27
segments: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he will hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows;

entries.title: Job 22:28
segments: And thou shalt decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee; and light shall shine upon thy ways.

entries.title: Job 22:29
segments: When they are made low, then thou shalt say, Rise up! and he shall save him that is of downcast eyes.

entries.title: Job 22:30
segments: [Even] him that is not innocent shall he deliver; yea, he shall be delivered by the pureness of thy hands.
